remarks: HUNTER’S PARADISE! Quiet country setting. Property features a rolling & wooded haven with lots of mature hardwoods, pines and a stream. Perfect for your future home, cabin or camping & hunting getaway. Newly installed driveway leads to a couple small clearings and a shed. Electricity on property and at the road. Located in fabulous Stockton with restaurants, and all local amenities. Just a short drive to Cassadaga & Chautauqua lakes & the charming villages of Bemus Point, Mayville & Lily Dale. Just 14 miles to Chautauqua Lake, 13 miles to Bemus Point, 2.7 miles to Cassadaga Lake,12 miles Mayville. Great opportunity to make this special property your perfect getaway!!!!
